title: Distance to nearest skew-symmetric matrix polynomials of bounded rank
summary: We propose an algorithm that approximates a given matrix polynomial of degree $d$ by another skew-symmetric matrix polynomial of a specified rank and degree at most $d$. The algorithm is built on recent advances in the theory of generic eigenstructures and factorizations for skew-symmetric matrix polynomials of bounded rank and degree. Taking into account that the rank of a skew-symmetric matrix polynomial is even, the algorithm works for any prescribed even rank greater than or equal to $2$ and produces a skew-symmetric matrix polynomial of that exact rank.
